Row.Text: [B]England[/B] is able to endure throughout the Ages.
[B]Alexander[/B] and [B]England[/B] both like Cities more than Towns. Especially if they can rename them.
Have a City on an [B]Island[/B] (a landmass with a maximum of 30 tiles).
The British Isles were an important part of [B]England's[/B] identity.

Across the whale-road, island folk forge a haven from a lonely place. They are masters of their small land, reaping rich harvests from field and sea, and rich profit from crafted goods. But at times their eyes follow the screaming gulls across the salt waves, and they wonder: what other wealth does this world hold?
